The underlying idea is that energy and resources invested in reproduction may lead to compromises in repair and maintenance, thereby hindering a long life. Thus, the assumption is that particularly successful reproduction at a young age comes at the cost of a shorter lifespan.
items.imageAlt: Why fertile male killifish outlive their peers
